name: Holy Virgin Cathedral
note: church() kit + hand-built primitives, sf/churches-4.ts: Russian Orthodox cathedral, archetype church, 5 levels/19m tag (corrected to a 12m nave ridge; the tag reads as including the dome). church()'s Tower.top has no onion-dome case -- its only bulbous options (dome, lantern) use a monotonically shrinking radius and read as the wrong religion -- so the onion dome and its drum are hand-built primitives placed with church()'s own bounding-box transform. Restrained to ONE dome over the roof centre rather than a guessed five-dome cluster; no photograph. Escalated from batch 5 on FORM (onion domes).

name: Saint John's Presbyterian Church
note: church() kit, sf/churches-4.ts: archetype church, 4 levels/15m tag, no name detail beyond the church tag. No photograph -- restrained textbook parish form, one front-corner tower, square chancel, brick. Escalated from batch 5 on FORM.

name: Star of the Sea Catholic Church
note: church() kit, sf/churches-4.ts: escalated on tag AND geometry (form.arc:8 vs form.ortho:57 -- two monotonic heading sweeps, curved apse/tower plus a chamfered bay rhythm). church()'s chancel:'apse' (half-octagon) and tower plan:'octagon' already read round at range, which is what both sweeps ask for -- no primitives needed. The chamfered bay rhythm is a facade detail below Walls' slot vocabulary and is left off rather than guessed, with no photograph to confirm it. 12m tag corrected up to a 14m nave ridge -- read as an eaves height on this footprint, not a ridge. Escalated from batch 6 on tag and geometry.
